name: Entschuldigung
source:
Entschuldigung (which means ‘sorry’ in German) is a bleak horror story, told by a lost young man who longs to find a place in which he can feel safe. Set in pre-war Berlin, the story is driven by an insatiable curiosity that leads our protagonist down a very dark path into the unknown. As he fights to make sense of his reality, he is also fighting to make sense of himself.
Entschuldigung features unique gameplay mechanics that heighten the intensity of an already disturbing tale.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/570350/]Steam[/url]]
